newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal Realty files for unit spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal Realty files for unit spinoff.

text.p: Cardinal Realty Services Inc said on Thursday it is proposing to spin off the majority of its apartment properties and modify its corporate structure so it could focus on management of real estate.

Pending Securities and Exchange Commission and shareholder approvals, 66 of Cardinal Realty's 113 wholly owned apartment properties will have a majority of their ownership interests held by a real estate investment trust.
Cardinal Realty said 93 percent of the common stock of the new apartment business would be issued to shareholders in a dividend.
Cardinal Realty said approximately 11 additional wholly owned properties could be added to the spin off company at Cardinal Realty's discretion, if it is approved by mortgage lenders.
The remainder of the apartment complexes would be put up for sale, Cardinal Realty said.
The spinoff would be considered at the company's next annual meeting or at a special shareholder meeting.
